group.ja: 最適化・確率・逆問題

summary.ja: Bratuの合成観測から係数を推定し、2パラメータの随伴勾配、正則化の偏り、観測感度の特異値と識別不能例を検証する。
summary.en: Fit Bratu coefficients from synthetic observations and verify two-parameter adjoint gradients, regularization bias, data-sensitivity singular values and nonidentifiable observations.

references.label: A new approach to variable metric algorithms (1970)
references.scope: Method-specific source; see the detailed reading for source role and actual review depth.

references.label: Minimization of functions having Lipschitz continuous first partial derivatives (1966)
references.scope: Original sufficient-decrease and backtracking construction; the detailed chapter distinguishes the local projected implementation from the original theorem.

references.label: Regularization Tools, Version 4.1 manual (March 2008)
references.scope: Author official manual; the detailed chapter records the selected SVD and standard-form Tikhonov/nonzero-prior passages consulted. The local Bratu implementation is independent of the MATLAB toolbox.

assumptions: Smooth lower-branch Bratu states on a fixed mesh with a locally nonsingular state Jacobian and fixed zero Dirichlet data.
The new spatial coefficient is lambda(x)=a+b(2x-1), with a in [1,2.8] and b in [-0.5,0.5]; this extends the earlier constant-lambda model.
Fixed synthetic observations, positive weights and explicitly stated parameter scales, priors and regularization strengths; data-only sensitivity rank is separate from a regularized system rank.
units: Dimensionless state, coordinate and coefficients. Observation weights and parameter scales are explicit; singular values and regularization strengths depend on those scales.
boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(1)=0 independent of both coefficients; fixed observation locations on [0,1].

next_deliverable.ja: データに基づく正則化強度の選択、多数係数、実測データ、より一般的な最適化法の独立検証。
next_deliverable.en: Separate validation for data-driven regularization selection, many coefficients, real data and more general optimization methods.

limitations.ja: 小規模な滑らかなBratu下側分枝と固定合成観測による教育用検証。2パラメータ空間係数の推定、Tikhonov正則化、局所的なデータ感度のSVD、中央観測の階数不足と反射対称性による曖昧さを扱う。正則化による事前値の選択を観測情報の増加と解釈しない。実測データ、多数係数の関数推定、大域的一意性、統計的信頼区間、準Newton法全般は検証しない。
limitations.en: Educational tests use small smooth lower-branch Bratu problems and fixed synthetic observations. They cover two spatial coefficients, Tikhonov regularization, local data-sensitivity SVD, rank loss with central observations and reflection ambiguity. Prior selection through regularization does not add observational information. Real data, high-dimensional function estimation, global uniqueness, statistical confidence intervals and quasi-Newton methods generally are outside scope.

metadata_review.level: two-parameter adjoint fitting; regularization and data-only identifiability checks; earlier scalar supplement retained

assumptions_ja: 固定格子・固定ゼロDirichlet境界の滑らかなBratu下側分枝を用い、状態ヤコビ行列が局所的に可逆である。
新しい空間係数はλ(x)=a+b(2x−1)、a∈[1,2.8]、b∈[−0.5,0.5]であり、以前の定数λモデルを拡張する。
合成観測と正の重みを固定し、パラメータの尺度・事前値・正則化強度を明記する。データだけの感度行列の階数と、正則化後の系の階数を区別する。
units_ja: 状態・座標・係数は無次元。観測重みとパラメータ尺度を明記し、特異値と正則化強度の尺度依存を区別する。
boundary_conditions_ja: u(0)=u(1)=0を両係数に依存せず固定し、観測位置も区間[0,1]内で固定する。
code_mapping_scope: Primary immutable two-parameter spatial-coefficient Bratu supplement with adjoint fitting, Tikhonov regularization and data-only SVD identifiability checks. The previous scalar inverse supplement remains available as scalar_inverse_release; neither edition establishes general inverse-problem validity.
run_from: Extracted multi-parameter Bratu inverse supplement directory
